chapter.verse: Keima pumpi kitheihna lungsim in Kha Siangtho tawh kibangin kei lamsang ah teci hong pang khawmin, zuauthu gen loin Khazih mai-ah aman takpi ka cih-inah,
ka dah mahmah a, ka lungsim sungah tawlnga loin lungmangin gimin ka om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ci leh sa lamsang ah ka pawl ahi ka u ka naute tang ding Khazih tawh kikhenin hamsiatna thuak dingin lungsim ka nei hi.

Tua mite in Israel mite ahih uh ciangin a ta za-a kikoih nading ahi zongin, vangliatna ahi zongin, thu kiciamnate ahi zongin, Thukham koihna ahi zongin, Pasian biakna ahi zongin, thuciamnate ahi zongin,

amau ading a pute a pate tawh kizoma piang mi zong ahi uh hi. Khazih in zong ci leh sa lamsang ah tua mite pawl ahi hi. Tua Khazih in zong na khempeuh uk a, thupha a ngah tawntung Pasian ahi hi. Amen.
Tua bang ka cih hangin Pasian’ thu a kip kei hi, ka cihnopna ahi kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Israel’ suante khempeuh in Israel mi taktak ahi kei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Abraham’ suan khempeuh in Abraham’ tate taktak ahi kei hi, “Isaak bekah na suan a kici ding hi,” ci-in Pasian in Abraham kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ci leh sa tate in Pasian’ tate taktak ahi kei uh hi, thuciamna tawh kipawl tate in a suan taktak a kici hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thuciamna in, “Tu hun hong tung kik ciangin ka hong pai kik ding a, Sarah in ta a nei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tham loin Rebekah in eite pu Isaak tawh a gai khit ciangin
Pasian teelkhiatna tawh kipawl hanciamna in gamtatna hang hi lo, a hong sampa’ deihna hangin a kip theih nading ta a suah ma-in amaute in gamtat hoih, gamtat hoih lo a neih ma-un
“A ta uzaw in a ta nauzaw’ na sem ding hi,” ci-in tua numei kiangah a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin, “Jakob ka it hi, Esau ka mudah hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang i ci gen ding hiam? Pasian in thuman lo bawlpa ahi, i ci ding hiam? Tua bang i ci zenzen kei ding hi.
“Keimah in ka hehpih nopte ka hehpih ding hi. Ka gup nopte ka gum ding hi,” ci-in Moses kiangah thu a pia hi.
Tua bang ahih ciangin a deih mi tawh a kikum kei hi, a hanciam mi tawh zong a kikum kei hi, hong hehpih thei Pasian bek tawh kikum hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah Faro kumpipa kiangah, “Ka vangliatna nangma tungah ka lah nading ahi zongin, ka min leitung khempeuh ah a kizelh nading ahi zongin nangmah kong sangsak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin a hehpih nopte a hehpih hi, a lungkhauhsak nopte a lungkhauhsak hi.
“Tua bang ahih ciangin, ‘Pasian in bang hangin ko hong mawhsak lai hiam? Kua in a deihna a khamsak hiam’” ci-in keimah hong dong ding na hi uh hi.
Pasian a nial mi aw, nang kua mi na hi hiam? A kibawl mi in, “Bang hangin kei hong hi ci bawl hiam?” ci-in a bawlpa kiangah a gen ding hiam?
Beel seekpa in beel lei uk hilo ahi hiam? Beel lei lom khat tawh beel manpha ahi zongin, beel manpha lo ahi zongin bawl thei hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian in ama hehna hong lak a, a vangliatna a kitheihsak nading a deih maninah a kisia ding a bawlsa, hehna a thuak beelte a lungneemna tawh a thuak leh, bang gen ding a om lai hiam?
A vangliatna a lah nading a masa a bawlsa hehpihna a ngah belte ahi
Judah mipawl sung pan bek hi lo, Gentailte sung panin zong hong sap eite tungah a kicing vangliatna a kilat nadingin hong bawl leh, bang gen ding a om hiam?
Hosea Lai Siangtho sungah: “Keima mi ahi lote, ‘Keima mite hi,’ ka ci ding hi; Ka ngaih loh mi in, ‘Ka ngaih mi hi,’ ka ci ding hi.
Note in, ‘Keima mite na hi kei uh hi,’ a cihna munah, ‘A nungta Pasian’ tapate kicihna a ngah ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen bang ahi hi.
Isaiah in Israel thu panin, “Israel mipawlte in tuipi sehnel zahin a tam hangin a kimkhat bek in gupna a ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa in leitung ah ama thukhenna kipsak a, manlangin a zo ding hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Isaiah in:, “Vantung Topa in eite ading khaici hong omsak lai hi kei leh, Eite in Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate i bang zo ding hi,” ci-in a masa-a a gen bang ahi hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang i ci gen ding hiam? Dikna a delh lo Gentailte in tua-upna tawh kipawl dikna a cihnopna ahi dikna a tung uh hi.
Ahih hangin dikna thukhamna a delh uh Israelte in tua dikna thukham ah a tung zo kei uh hi.

Bang hangin tung zo lo ahi uh hiam na cih uh leh, thu-upna tawh a delh kei uh hi, thukham gamtatna tawh a delh uh hi. Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, amaute in sui-a kipuk na’ng suang a sui kha uh hi.
A kigelhna in: “Ngai un, sui-a kipuk khak na’ng suangpi leh mawhsak na’ng suangpi Zion mual tungah ka koih hi. Tua suangpi a um mi in zumna a thuak kei ding hi,” ahi hi.
